scope_lock.acceptance: Every canonical surface and major data path is classified before feature placement; no duplicate owner is introduced.
Discovery owns a market-session-aware broad low-cost scan that rotates a bounded U.S. universe and does not permanently stream the full market.

Radar uses session-normalized volume, dollar-volume/liquidity gates, range/volatility expansion, persistence, price confirmation and material catalyst context without becoming a profit promise or protected desk score.
Qualified candidates reuse existing livePriorityHints/reserve slots, cap promotions, preserve active-user symbols, use hysteresis and expire when not reconfirmed.
Existing market-activity, news/catalyst and permitted fused community evidence are reused as contextual Radar inputs instead of creating orphan fetches or parallel evidence stores.
Session, hot-symbol state and provider health adapt Radar/history/cache cadence within bounded observable policies; new promotions get targeted history hydration.
A new material Radar promotion can create one stable Smart Notification; recomputation does not manufacture repeated alerts.
Shadow alternatives are observable but cannot mutate production until SHADOW -> VALIDATED -> APPROVED -> PRODUCTION.
v16.9 30/30 closure, US Equities boundary, Provider Router authority, deterministic equivalence and No Execution Boundary remain intact.
Rapid dislocation merges into Radar; other proposed capabilities are placed/deferred explicitly without creating duplicate tabs or silently expanding scope.
